name: ZeroSpace Radio
summary: The underground has no orbit. ZeroSpace Radio is a free social idle game for the browser: build an underground broadcast empire among the stars. Find profiles on Contract Radar and sign them to your roster, grow ten orbital outposts, and let your network earn while you're away. Reach level 50 to build your Hall of Fame, then prestige into Resonance for a new run with lasting benefits. Optional 28-day seasons bring a fresh economy and a separate leaderboard.
